evidence.detail: Base display name is 'Configs'; uses config_version, archive configs.zip and progress label 'Downloading game configs..'.
Concrete AssetUpdater downloads/extracts the configs archive into the configured cache configs directory.

proposals.note: Role is exact from asset name/archive/version key.

evidence.detail: Base display name is 'Cache'; uses key cache_version, archive cache.zip and progress label 'Downloading main game assets..'.
Downloads and extracts the main cache while deliberately preserving sprite/config subtrees handled by their own updaters.

proposals.note: Role is exact from asset name, version key and archive behavior.

evidence.detail: Two enum values contain the complete user-facing version-check failure and game-asset download failure messages.
AssetUpdater records these enum messages when remote version lookup or concrete asset download fails.

proposals.note: Enum is the error vocabulary for the updater subsystem.

evidence.detail: Downloads /assets/client.jar with progress label 'Downloading client..' and tracks client_version.
Concrete AssetUpdater deletes/recreates the client destination and verifies the downloaded client.jar exists.

proposals.note: Role is exact from target artifact and version key.

evidence.detail: Abstract class owns URL + destination File, streams bytes through BufferedInputStream/FileOutputStream, tracks content length/bytes/time and invokes one abstract progress callback while downloading.
The concrete operation deletes an existing destination, downloads to disk in 16 KiB chunks, periodically flushes, and returns the completed File.

proposals.note: FileDownloader describes the exact generic download primitive.

evidence.detail: Coordinator constructs CacheUpdater, SpriteUpdater and ConfigUpdater, injects the Client, compares local/remote versions, invokes updates and prints updater error lists.
Exact strings include 'Please wait, checking assets..', 'Updating outdated game asset:', and per-updater error messages for cache, sprite and configuration updates.

proposals.note: Manager name follows exact coordination/version-check behavior.

evidence.detail: Abstract base stores updater display name, Client and errors; requires update(), AssetVersion accessor and capability flag; implements version parsing and ZIP extraction helpers.
AssetUpdateManager treats all concrete Cache/Client/Config/Sprite updaters through this common type.

proposals.note: AssetUpdater is the shared versioned-updater abstraction.

evidence.detail: Base display name is 'Sprites'; uses sprite_version, archive sprites.zip and progress label 'Downloading sprites..'.
Concrete AssetUpdater downloads/extracts the sprites archive into the configured cache sprites directory.

proposals.note: Role is exact from asset name/archive/version key.

evidence.detail: Stores local version-file path plus a version key, reads remote versions.txt and local versions.dat, rewrites one key/value, and exposes remote/local numeric versions.
Connection failure UI explicitly reports inability to connect to the SpawnPK server while retrieving version state.

proposals.note: Value/service object is specifically the local/remote asset version tracker.

evidence.detail: Subclass of FileDownloader adds Client + display label and implements the progress callback by computing percentage and kb/s or mb/s throughput.
Progress text includes '@yel@Current progress - ' and formatted transfer-rate output, then calls the Client loading/progress UI.

proposals.note: Name distinguishes this progress-reporting client-aware wrapper from the generic downloader.
